newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end down as early spurt fades.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end down as early spurt fades.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended lower on Thursday as an early buying spree, which pushed the market above key resistance at 21,300 points, ran out of steam.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended 50 points below its previous settlement at 21,225, after shooting to a high of 21,370.
"I expected 21,300 to be a support but it came down again so perhaps on the shorter-term outlook, there'll be a correction all the way down to 21,050/80," said a chartist at a local futures house.
He said the December Nikkei should then push above 21,370 and head for 21,450, followed by 21,620.
But if it struggled to get back above 21,250/70, further rises could be difficult, he added.
Dealers said the market had discounted news of Japan's Finance Ministry ordering the liquidation of Hanwa Bank, a second-tier regional bank, due to its bad debts.
